reasoning: IS CAGR is negative so the OOS/IS efficiency ratio is not meaningful and was not computed. Absolute OOS metrics all fail the vault thresholds: Sharpe -3.55 (vs >0.8 aim), profit factor 0.429 (vs >1.2 aim). OOS trades (477) clear the rule-of-30 easily but only confirm the loss is statistically real, not noise. OOS max drawdown (-0.4264) roughly equals OOS total return (-0.4257) -- the strategy's entire lifetime return is erased by its own drawdown. Fold parameter stability is fine (3 distinct values per param across 65 folds) but moot given the strategy loses money in-sample already, before any generalization gap.
